propositions: Ticking acceptance criteria checkboxes does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint basis by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing.

The current attestation staleness message names a fixed fictional component list (description/AC/file_impact/children) instead of identifying which actual component in the material basis (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children, file_impact_scope) actually changed.

Per-component fingerprints must be signed in the manifest and retrieved from the signed record, not reconstructed at read time, because children are derived from other tickets' state and cannot be reliably replayed.

Pre-330c attestations that hashed raw description and are later read after checkbox ticking report stale-material spuriously because neither the normalized recompute nor the legacy grandfather can match, hiding the real cause in a generic message.

The fix adds material-part lines to the signed manifest and per-component tracking to enable explain_material_change to report which specific components differ with before/after counts rather than a generic list.

Attestation refusal messages across all surfaces (unsigned gate, stale-reopened, signing failures, dependency changes, child closure reasons) must be updated to forward or compute component-specific reasons instead of fixed lists or generic advice.
